headline: Ex-OpenAI worker accused of spying with alleged Saudi ties
summary: A former OpenAI employee is accused of spying, with a folder called 'Saudi Gov Docs' found on their devices and allegations of Saudi government support, including for planting a device. US authorities reportedly fear Saudi backing could help the accused flee the charges; the Saudi government did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
